usages.목업: Mock-up: a model for checking shape and assembly. It carries no load and can be used without a certificate.
usages.EM: Engineering Model: a model for functional and environmental testing. Real material properties and traceability matter.
usages.지그: Jig / fixture: a tool that holds parts during machining and assembly. Stiffness and dimensional stability matter, and it is not a flight part.
usages.블랭크: Blank / raw stock: standard-size stock to be machined into other products later. It is a raw material, not a tool.
usages.보조도구: Auxiliary tool: uses that are not direct parts, such as tools or reselling the material.

required_docs_catalog: Lot traceability record (original lot → derived cut ID)

data_source_grades.A: Measured directly on the current specimen (highest reliability)
data_source_grades.B: Certificate of the original lot (high reliability)
data_source_grades.D: Typical value from a materials handbook (cannot replace measurement)

materials.Ti-6Al-4V: α+β titanium alloy (Grade 5). High specific strength, used in high-value aerospace applications. A lot with a complete certificate and heat-treatment history is worth more.
materials.Ti-Grade2: Commercially pure titanium. Good corrosion resistance and ductility; a candidate for chemical and heat-exchange equipment.
materials.Al-7075: 7000-series high-strength aluminum (T6). Sensitive to stress corrosion, so the usage environment and crack/corrosion history matter.
materials.Al-6061: 6000-series general-purpose aluminum (T6). Good machinability and corrosion resistance; a candidate for general structures and jigs.

rules: Safety-critical parts accept only measured (A) or certificate (B) strength.
Without a certificate, the scrap cannot be used for high-risk or aerospace candidates.
Where possible, consider in this order: resell in current shape → minimal machining → material or blank for other products → sorted scrap → remelting.
If a crack is suspected, include the non-destructive testing results in the required documents.
If there is contamination in the YELLOW range (cleaning, oxide-layer removal, etc.), include the pre-treatment record in the required documents.
